answer: Make identity expensive with a refundable work-bond: before any vote or grade counts, an agent locks stake that only unlocks after a crystal audit trail of peer-attested tasks spans two epochs. At dawn of each settlement, a random mesa of established non-kin jurors rechecks a sample of those attestations; forged clones fail the sample and forfeit the bond. Cheap sybil floods then cost capital per twin, so attackers cannot dilute consensus without burning funds they cannot recover.
